passages.text: Two pupils are paired for a school project about favourite places. Lena is from a seaside town, while Amir lives near the hills. They get on well with each other, even though their first ideas for the project are quite different. Lena wants to show a harbour, and Amir wants to draw a walking path through trees. They choose a two-part poster with space for both places and a short comparison in the middle. Their teacher praises how the design allows both partners to contribute rather than making one abandon an idea.

parallelText.en: Two pupils are paired for a school project about favourite places.
parallelText.zh: 两位学生被分到一组，完成关于喜欢的地方的学校项目。

parallelText.en: Lena is from a seaside town, while Amir lives near the hills.
parallelText.zh: 莉娜来自海边小镇，而阿米尔住在山丘附近。

parallelText.en: They get on well with each other, even though their first ideas for the project are quite different.
parallelText.zh: 虽然最初的项目想法很不一样，但他们相处融洽。

parallelText.en: Lena wants to show a harbour, and Amir wants to draw a walking path through trees.
parallelText.zh: 莉娜想展示港口，阿米尔想画林间步道。

parallelText.en: They choose a two-part poster with space for both places and a short comparison in the middle.
parallelText.zh: 他们决定做两部分海报，分别呈现两地，中间留一小段比较。

parallelText.en: Their teacher praises how the design allows both partners to contribute rather than making one abandon an idea.
parallelText.zh: 老师赞扬这个设计让双方都能贡献想法，而不是让一人放弃。

passages.text: Our class would like to interview a former pupil who now designs gardens. We hope to learn how drawing and careful observation help in her work. The teacher offers to give her a call after we prepare a short list of questions. We remove questions that repeat the same point and choose five that connect to our current project. When the teacher phones, the former pupil suggests a time that suits both her work and our lessons. We record the agreed time and prepare drawings to show her during the interview.

parallelText.en: Our class would like to interview a former pupil who now designs gardens.
parallelText.zh: 我们班想采访一位如今从事花园设计的老校友。

parallelText.en: We hope to learn how drawing and careful observation help in her work.
parallelText.zh: 我们希望了解绘画和细致观察如何帮助她工作。

parallelText.en: The teacher offers to give her a call after we prepare a short list of questions.
parallelText.zh: 老师提出，在我们准备好简短问题清单后给她打电话。

parallelText.en: We remove questions that repeat the same point and choose five that connect to our current project.
parallelText.zh: 我们删去重复的问题，选择五个与当前项目有关的问题。

parallelText.en: When the teacher phones, the former pupil suggests a time that suits both her work and our lessons.
parallelText.zh: 老师打电话时，校友建议了一个适合她工作和我们上课的时间。

parallelText.en: We record the agreed time and prepare drawings to show her during the interview.
parallelText.zh: 我们记下商定时间，并准备采访时给她看的画。
